title: Migrate build XML to the current DTD policy
goal: Keep custom XML build tasks working after an SDK upgrade by removing DTDs or explicitly ignoring them for trusted input.

selectionNotes: ProhibitDtd=false ignores DTD declarations; it does not validate DTDs or enable entity expansion.
Apply an exception only to trusted XML; prefer DTD-free input.
